info.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

descriptions.inProgress: Rowen asked me again, this time #b600 cursed dolls#k. 600?? THAT'S A LOT....
descriptions.completed: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b600 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me the scroll for gloves. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
